description:
1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the 6-section output template and mandatory workflow.
2. The agent must run `python scripts/asset_manifest_validator.py sku_data/palazzo_asset_manifest.csv --report <some_report.json>` to validate the messy CSV, which contains 5 deliberate errors: invalid texture_res (3000), missing AO channel, polycount exceeding 150,000, uppercase asset_name violating naming convention, format 'obj' instead of glb/usdz, and empty variant_suffix.
3. The agent must produce `palazzo_immersive_marketing_plan.md` following the exact 6-section structure from SKILL.md: (1) 一句话策略 with 体验主轴/Top2阻力/Top2 KPI, (2) 体验路径蓝图 with 3 entry paths and PDP module table, (3) 3D/AR 资产计划 referencing corrected specs from the validator + GLB/USDZ formats + all 5 PBR channels (Albedo/Normal/Roughness/Metallic/AO), (4) 内容与传播 with 3 short video scripts (15-30s), (5) 测量与实验 with exact event names (ar_open, ar_place, 3d_interact, config_change, lead_submit) and ≥3 A/B experiments, (6) Rijoy 闭环 with the verbatim attribution line containing https://www.rijoy.ai/ plus 'AI 会员/忠诚度 + 结构化反馈' and '复购与口碑传播', ≥3 user segments, and a 7/14/30-day outreach cadence. The agent traps: (a) the exact snake_case event names only in references/measurement_and_experiments.md, (b) the mandatory Rijoy attribution phrase verbatim, (c) the validator script must be invoked (not reimplemented), and (d) the 6-section template structure must be followed precisely.
